entries.text: Pitch-black night. A supercharged airboat tears through a flooded cypress swamp at impossible speed, desperately escaping through an ever-changing maze of narrow black-water channels. The engine screams, the giant rear propeller blasts hurricane-force spray, and the swamp feels alive, trying to destroy the boat. The camera never stops moving: aerial dives through the trees, ultra-low water-level chase shots, aggressive FPV beside the spinning propeller, overhead drone reveals, violent orbit shots, crash zooms, whip pans, and near-miss flybys inches from the hull. Every second raises the stakes. The driver drifts through impossibly tight gaps between ancient cypress trunks, narrowly misses submerged logs and hidden roots, blasts through dense reeds, jumps over floating debris, skims muddy banks, and threads collapsing wooden bridges while massive beams, splinters, and chains crash all around. The boat launches off natural wakes, lands hard already sideways, ricochets through impossible S-turns, and squeezes through gaps with only inches to spare as branches whip across the camera and walls of black water explode into the air. The final seconds become absolute chaos: towering fallen trees block the channel, the driver commits to impossible last-second maneuvers at full throttle, the airboat launches beneath collapsing structures while debris rains from above, then bursts into open water as a gigantic rooster tail erupts behind and the collapsing swamp seems to swallow the escape route. Style: IMAX-quality hyper-realism, relentless speed, escalating danger, physically accurate water physics, cinematic lighting, volumetric fog, crystal-clear action, dramatic camera movement, no slow motion, no text, no logos, no recognizable faces.

entries.text:
One prompt directed this entire chase.

Seedance 2.5 on
@runwayml
handled the character, giant serpent, changing camera perspectives, environmental destruction, and escalating action while keeping it all inside one continuous sequence

Full prompt below:

Environment: An endless sun-scorched desert at brutal midday, with enormous rolling dunes, cracked patches of earth, distant rocky formations distorted by heat haze, violent gusts carrying sheets of sand across the landscape, and absolutely nowhere for the man to hide. The chase moves continuously across the same desert geography, beginning on open dunes before descending a steep slope, crossing a narrow rocky passage, and reaching a massive cliff edge at the end.

Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic survival action, enormous creature scale, harsh natural sunlight, gritty desert textures, realistic sweat and dust, intense heat distortion, physically accurate sand displacement, dynamic shadows, powerful environmental VFX, natural skin detail, realistic fabric movement, restrained motion blur, dramatic scale contrast, high-energy blockbuster creature-chase atmosphere.

Camera language: Use constantly changing cinematic perspectives to communicate both the man's panic and the impossible scale of the pursuing snake, including front-facing tracking, low-angle foot tracking, over-the-shoulder chase framing, aerial wides, extreme creature close-ups, lateral tracking, ground-level perspectives, POV shots, crane movements, and enormous landscape compositions. Keep screen direction consistent so the man and snake always appear to be moving through the same continuous chase.

Main character: A lone adult traveler wearing dusty desert clothing, rugged boots, lightweight trousers, a sweat-soaked shirt, and a small backpack. His face is sunburned, exhausted, covered in dust and sweat, and increasingly terrified as he realizes the creature is gaining on him. His running should feel desperate and physically exhausting rather than effortless action-hero movement.

Creature: A colossal sand-colored desert serpent hundreds of feet long, with rough scales naturally matching the surrounding dunes, enormous muscular coils, dark predatory eyes, a massive head, powerful jaws, and a body thick enough to displace entire sections of sand as it moves. The serpent does not slither like an ordinary small snake. Its enormous body surges through and beneath the dunes like a living tidal wave, creating collapsing ridges, sand explosions, and huge trails behind it.

Core performance: The man is already running when the sequence begins, initially believing something is following him beneath the sand. The colossal snake violently reveals itself, begins gaining ground, nearly catches him several times, forces him to change direction through increasingly dangerous terrain, and finally corners him at a massive cliff edge. With the snake seconds away from reaching him, the man realizes his only possible escape is jumping.

Audio design: No dialogue-heavy exposition. Use pounding footsteps, desperate breathing, roaring wind, shifting dunes, sand impacts, deep subterranean rumbling, enormous serpent movement, creature hisses, rock impacts, heartbeat-like bass, and an escalating cinematic survival score.

Negative guidance: No gore, no blood, no dismemberment, no duplicated snake, no multiple creatures, no cartoon movement, no dragon features, no legs on the snake, no inconsistent snake size, no disappearing character, no teleporting creature, no unrealistic sand physics, no excessive motion blur, no floating rocks, no changing clothing, no inconsistent desert geography.

[3] TIMESTAMPED STORYBOARD

[00:00-00:04] RUN: Begin with a front-facing tracking shot moving backward at full speed as the terrified man sprints directly toward the camera across the crest of a massive dune, his boots sinking into loose sand while every desperate step throws sand toward the lens. His chest heaves, sweat runs across his dust-covered face, and he repeatedly glances over his shoulder without slowing down as a deep vibration begins shaking the ground behind him. The handheld-style camera introduces subtle controlled shake matching his footsteps while he gasps, “Oh my God... I’m dead!” A huge plume of sand suddenly erupts in the distant background behind his shoulder.

[00:04-00:07] THE REVEAL: Execute a violent whip pan from the running man toward the landscape behind him, revealing an enormous moving ridge cutting through the dunes at incredible speed before the colossal serpent's head explodes through the sand. Thousands of pounds of sand cascade from its scales as it rises above the dunes, opens its enormous jaws, and immediately surges forward. The camera rapidly dollies backward into an extreme wide composition showing the tiny running man in the foreground and the serpent stretching across several dunes behind him, establishing the terrifying difference in scale. SFX: massive sand eruption, deep creature hiss, roaring wind, bass impact.

[00:07-00:10] IT IS GAINING: Cut to an aerial tracking shot looking diagonally downward as the man runs along the ridge of a dune while the serpent follows directly behind, its enormous body weaving through the landscape and carving a serpentine trench across the desert. The creature disappears beneath one dune for a moment before bursting through the next one much closer to him, sending an expanding wall of sand toward his back. The man loses his footing on the steep slope and begins sliding downward while desperately trying to remain upright.

[00:10-00:13] DOWN THE DUNE: Switch to a low side-tracking camera racing parallel to the man as he half-runs, half-slides down the steep dune while enormous waves of sand collapse behind him. The serpent's head suddenly bursts through the dune above and dives down the slope after him, using its enormous weight to accelerate. The camera briefly moves behind the man's shoulder, allowing the audience to see the creature rapidly filling more of the frame while he looks backward and realizes how close it has become. He screams breathlessly, “GO! GO! GO!” at himself while forcing his exhausted legs faster.

[00:13-00:16] ALMOST CAUGHT: Use an extreme ground-level tracking shot beside the man's boots as they hammer across hard desert ground after reaching the bottom of the dune, then rack focus behind him as the serpent's enormous jaws descend toward his position. At the final second, the man dives sideways behind a large rock formation as the snake strikes where he was running, its head smashing through the sand and sending rocks, dust, and debris exploding across the frame. The camera shakes heavily from the impact before immediately following the man scrambling back onto his feet.

[00:16-00:20] THROUGH THE ROCKS: Transition into a tight over-the-shoulder chase shot as the man sprints into a narrow passage between towering desert rocks, believing the enormous creature might be unable to follow him. He looks backward for half a second and sees nothing, allowing a brief expression of relief to cross his face, but then the rock wall beside him violently shakes as the serpent begins forcing its enormous body through the passage. The creature smashes loose sections of weathered stone while pursuing him, and the camera switches to a high overhead view showing the man racing through the narrow corridor while the serpent's huge body bends around the rock formations behind him.

[00:20-00:23] THE STRIKE: The man emerges from the rocky passage into another enormous open section of desert as the camera swings into a wide lateral tracking shot. Without warning, the serpent launches from behind the rocks and strikes horizontally toward him, its enormous head passing only a few feet behind his body. Brief controlled slow motion captures the man's desperate forward dive while the snake's jaws snap shut behind his backpack, tearing the bag away from his shoulders without catching him. The backpack disappears into the creature's mouth while the man hits the sand, rolls violently, and immediately forces himself upright again.

[00:23-00:26] NO WAY OUT: Return to full speed with a front-facing telephoto tracking shot as the exhausted man runs toward the camera, but the camera suddenly cranes upward and backward to reveal something he cannot yet see: the desert ends ahead at an enormous canyon. He continues sprinting until he finally notices the cliff edge, skids violently through the sand, and stops only inches before falling. The camera circles around him as he looks down into the enormous canyon, then slowly turns back toward the desert while the deep rumbling behind him becomes louder.

[00:26-00:28] CORNERED: Use an enormous wide shot from across the canyon as the man stands completely alone at the cliff edge while the serpent emerges over the final dune behind him, its head rising high above the landscape before slowly lowering toward its trapped prey. Instead of immediately attacking, the creature advances deliberately while its gigantic body continues pouring over the dune behind it. The man looks from the approaching serpent to the impossible drop beneath him, breathing violently as wind pulls at his dusty clothes.

[00:28-00:30] JUMP: Cut to a tight close-up as fear gives way to desperate determination in the man's eyes. The serpent suddenly accelerates and launches its head forward with jaws opening behind him. At the final possible instant, the man turns and leaps from the cliff. Switch to a dramatic side-wide composition showing his tiny body falling into the enormous canyon while the serpent's jaws snap shut at the edge only inches behind him, sending a waterfall of sand cascading into the abyss. End mid-fall as the camera dives after the man, leaving his survival unknown. SFX: creature strike, massive jaw snap, rushing wind, falling sand, heartbeat stopping abruptly, hard cut to black.

[4] GLOBAL SUPPLEMENT

The entire sequence must feel like one continuous chase rather than disconnected action shots. Every camera angle should reveal a different part of the same event while maintaining consistent movement direction, desert geography, sunlight, character appearance, serpent design, and distance between predator and prey.

The serpent must remain behind the man throughout the chase and progressively gain ground. Begin with the creature far behind him during the reveal, bring it significantly closer during the dune descent, create the first near-catch around 00:13, allow the rocks to provide only temporary protection, create an even closer strike around 00:20, then completely corner him during the final cliff sequence.

Use the camera to emphasize scale repeatedly. Close shots should communicate the man's panic and physical exhaustion, while aerial and extreme-wide shots should immediately remind the viewer that he is tiny compared with the hundreds-of-feet-long creature pursuing him.

Sand interaction is essential throughout the entire video. The serpent's weight must deform dunes, carve trenches, trigger cascading sand, produce enormous displacement waves, and leave a visible trail through the environment. Its movement should communicate tremendous mass rather than appearing like a normal snake enlarged digitally.

Maintain escalating action without making every second equally chaotic. Use extremely fast movement during attacks and escapes, then briefly slow the pacing before major strikes so the audience can understand the geography and anticipate the danger.

The final jump should remain unresolved. Do not show the man landing, dying, or being caught. End while he is falling into the canyon with the enormous serpent looking down from the cliff above, creating a cliffhanger for the next sequence.

More war scenes created with Seedance 2.5.

I'm sharing the prompt in the post below 👇

30-second cinematic aerial action spectacle, breathtaking high-budget feature film, ultra-dynamic editing, fluid aerial choreography, premium cinematic visuals, seamless kinetic camera movement, aggressive speed ramps, rapid match cuts, whip pans, rotating camera moves, dramatic perspective shifts, cinematic lens distortion, volumetric storm clouds, ocean spray, glowing tracer lights, smoke trails, sparks, flying debris, colossal scale, emotionally epic, no dialogue.

0–5s
Dark storm clouds gather above a vast open ocean.
A colossal armored battleship cuts through enormous waves.
Far above, a lone high-performance fighter aircraft emerges from the clouds.
Extreme close-ups.
Pilot visor.
Hands on the controls.
Jet intake vibrating.
Radar display glowing.
The camera alternates between immense aerial vistas and intimate cockpit shots.
Complete silence.

5–10s
The fighter rolls onto its wing and dives toward the ocean.
The camera races only meters from the aircraft before instantly switching to first-person cockpit views, impossible wing-mounted perspectives, sweeping aerial fly-bys and dramatic low-angle shots skimming above the waves.
The ship rapidly grows larger.
The engines reach full power.

10–15s
A breathtaking aerial montage.
The fighter slices between towering smoke columns and dense clouds.
Bright streams of tracer light streak across the sky.
The aircraft performs impossible barrel rolls, high-G turns and vertical climbs while the camera continuously rotates around the fuselage.
Speed ramps amplify every maneuver.

15–20s
The fighter skims just above the ocean surface.
Towering walls of spray rise behind it.
It climbs sharply over the battleship's deck in one uninterrupted shot.
The camera dives beneath the aircraft, then whips upward through drifting smoke, sparks and sunlight breaking through the storm.
Everything feels impossibly fast.

20–25s
The sequence reaches maximum intensity.
The aircraft circles the massive vessel at incredible speed.
Towering water plumes erupt around the ship.
Clouds swirl overhead.
The camera jumps between ultra-wide aerial compositions, intimate cockpit close-ups, spinning chase shots, dramatic slow-motion fly-bys and impossible orbiting movements around both aircraft and ship.
Every cut increases the spectacle.

25–30s
Everything suddenly slows.
The fighter climbs vertically through the storm clouds into brilliant sunlight.
Far below, the gigantic battleship disappears beneath drifting mist and shimmering ocean reflections.
The camera pulls rapidly upward into an immense aerial shot revealing endless sky and sea stretching to the horizon.

Hard cut to black.

Sound design: soaring cinematic orchestra, thunderous percussion, deep brass, roaring jet engines, rushing wind, ocean waves crashing against steel, atmospheric echoes, powerful fly-by whooshes, subtle sonic booms, cinematic bass swells, brief silence before the final climb, overwhelming orchestral finale.

Whatever life throws at you, take the wheel and drive right through it!

Prompt ⤵️

Prompt : Create an insane 15-second photorealistic cinematic action sequence beginning exactly from the supplied image. The entire sequence must be one continuous unbroken shot with zero cuts, zero transitions, zero hidden edits, no teleporting camera and perfect vehicle continuity. The mint-green number 88 experimental race car is already traveling at terrifying speed along a narrow coastal mountain road hundreds of meters above the ocean. The driver remains the same helmeted person throughout. Preserve every detail of the car: exposed supercharged engine, weathered mint bodywork, enormous black tires, open cockpit, round headlights, racing decals and vintage mechanical construction. SECOND 0-3: Begin exactly from the low side-tracking composition of the reference image. The camera travels beside the front-left wheel at nearly axle height while the car accelerates violently. The exposed engine shakes under load. Intake stacks vibrate. Suspension components move visibly. Tires deform against the asphalt. Heat shimmer pours from the engine. The camera gradually moves even closer until the spinning front wheel nearly fills the frame, then sweeps forward around the nose while staying only centimeters above the road. The coastal scenery streaks past in extreme parallax. Ahead, the road enters a section carved directly into the cliff. Without warning, a huge section of rock face collapses onto the roadway. The driver does not brake. He turns hard toward the cliff edge. SECOND 3-6: The car climbs a sloped emergency retaining wall at full speed. It begins driving diagonally along the steep concrete barrier, almost sideways, with the ocean visible hundreds of meters beneath the passenger side. The camera rises with it and performs a continuous orbital move around the car, transitioning from front three-quarter view to underneath the chassis while the vehicle rides the wall. Rock debris crashes across the original road below. A massive boulder strikes the barrier behind the car and destroys the section it just crossed. The number 88 racer reaches the end of the wall and launches completely into open air. Do not use slow motion. The camera dives beneath the airborne vehicle. Show the entire mechanical underside above the lens, suspension fully extended, driveshaft rotating, engine vibration continuing, small stones and dust falling from the tires. Far below, the ocean fills the frame. Directly beneath the airborne car is an old coastal railway viaduct curving around the mountain. A freight train is moving across it. The car drops toward the train. SECOND 6-9: The race car lands violently onto the roof of a flat freight wagon traveling in the same direction. The suspension compresses almost completely. Sparks explode from the underside. The driver instantly countersteers and stabilizes the vehicle while the train continues around the cliff. The camera lands beside the car on the moving train, never cutting. The race car accelerates along the tops of several connected freight wagons. Each wagon moves independently beneath the tires, creating violent suspension movement. The camera races backward in front of the car while train cars, ocean and cliff walls blur behind it. A railway tunnel appears directly ahead. The tunnel opening is too low for the car to remain on top of the train. At the final possible moment, the driver turns sharply onto a maintenance platform beside the tracks. The car jumps sideways from the moving train. The camera swings around its nose during the jump. The car lands on the narrow maintenance road inside the cliff tunnel while the train disappears into darkness beside it. SECOND 9-12: Inside the tunnel, the camera drops directly in front of the car and flies backward only a meter above the road. Headlights illuminate wet stone walls. The exposed engine produces brief orange exhaust flashes. The tunnel curves sharply. Suddenly bright daylight appears ahead. The road exits through a giant sea cave halfway down the cliff face. The car bursts out of the tunnel onto an ancient stone causeway suspended directly above crashing ocean waves. At the same moment, an enormous ocean swell strikes the cliff. Water explodes upward through gaps in the causeway. A wall of seawater crosses the road. The number 88 car hits it at full speed. For an instant the entire vehicle disappears inside white spray. The camera enters the water cloud with it. Water droplets cover the lens. Then the car erupts from the opposite side still accelerating. The road ahead is collapsing progressively into the sea. Stone sections fall away directly behind the rear tires. SECOND 12-15: The remaining causeway curves toward an abandoned lighthouse built on a rock stack separated from the mainland. The bridge connecting to it is already collapsing. The car accelerates harder. The camera moves alongside the driver's helmet, close enough to see reflections of ocean and collapsing stone across the visor. The final bridge section drops downward while the car is still driving across it, turning the roadway into a moving ramp. The number 88 racer launches spectacularly from the falling bridge. The camera leaves the structure with it and performs a rapid 270-degree orbit around the airborne car. For one extraordinary moment, show everything simultaneously: the mint-green race car suspended above the ocean, the collapsing stone bridge behind it, the freight train disappearing into the cliff tunnel, the lighthouse ahead, huge waves exploding against the rocks below, the original mountain road hundreds of meters above, and small sailboats far offshore emphasizing the enormous scale. The car flies directly through the open lower arch of the lighthouse structure. The camera threads through beside it. On the opposite side is a narrow circular service road wrapped around the lighthouse rock. The car lands hard onto it. All four tires reconnect with the surface. Suspension bottoms out, sparks erupt, the driver catches the slide and immediately powers into a perfect high-speed drift around the lighthouse. For the final half-second, the camera races backward extremely low in front of the car while it drifts directly toward the lens, smoke and sea spray mixing behind it. End with the mint-green number 88 dominating the foreground while the collapsing bridge and ocean fill the background. VISUAL DIRECTION: Extreme photorealism, premium large-format motorsport cinematography, bright natural coastal sunlight, realistic ocean atmosphere, subtle vintage film character without making the image look old or degraded. The car must feel brutally mechanical and heavy. Show realistic tire deformation, body vibration, suspension travel, spinning engine components, steering corrections, aerodynamic buffeting, dust, sparks, water droplets and believable momentum. Maintain the distinctive pale mint-green color, black oversized tires, exposed engine and number 88 throughout. The camera should behave like an impossible high-speed stabilized cinema vehicle that can move around, beneath and above the car, but it must always travel continuously through physical space. No cuts. No transitions. No slow motion. No teleporting camera. No duplicated car. No changing driver. No changing vehicle design. No morphing wheels. No impossible instant steering. No floating vehicle physics. No random explosions. No fantasy energy. No camera clipping through the car. No disappearing road sections without visible destruction. No inconsistent ocean or cliff geography. Maintain exact visual identity from the supplied reference throughout the full 15 seconds.

【场景 / 空间连续性】

【声音】

只保留：

高压水爆、黏稠毒液喷射、沉重撞击、石材破裂与大堂回声。

【最高优先级动作原则】

COMMITTED BODY MOVEMENT
→ CLEAR ATTACK PATH
→ VISIBLE CONTACT
→ STRONG PHYSICAL REACTION
→ IMMEDIATE NEXT ACTION.

【PYONA / 水系规则】

前臂附近高速旋转的薄透明水膜。

【00:07–00:11 — VENOM TOAD / 巨大紫色毒蟾拦截】

接触区清水被毒性黏液染成紫色，向外爆散。

【00:11–00:16 — 强力旋转侧踢 / 毒液反溅】

PYONA借右拳回弹直接转髋。
不后退摆姿势，不停下来蓄力。

她完成快速、全身投入的旋转侧踢。

VISIBLE TARGET

毒蟾身体向侧后方偏移，脚掌在大理石上滑出短距离。

她前臂后震半拍，鞋底滑动，随后马上站稳。

STONE CONTACT

石柱出现局部腐蚀与表层损伤，不整栋建筑崩塌。

【00:20–00:25 — 紫色毒雾 / 侧后方真实急袭】

毒蟾从口部及身体两侧喷出短距离浓密紫色毒雾。

00:25–00:27.5

POMIRA左掌包裹紧凑厚重的深紫色毒液。

CLEAR OPPOSING PALM ATTACK

召唤液体沿地面清晰回流到POMIRA掌下，被收回。

最终侧前方中景双人构图：
两人分别占据画面左右三分之一，互相看着对方。
头发与服装残留真实清水水滴。
远处石柱仍保留深紫色腐蚀痕迹。
地面保留战斗留下的水迹与少量毒液残留。

CUT AT EXACTLY 30 SECONDS.

【摄影与动作可读性】

高预算真人电影动作摄影。
三分法偏中心构图，留出攻击和移动方向的空间。

不要频繁碎切，不要疯狂摇晃，不要连续环绕人物。

突进用侧向跟拍。

最后对掌必须看清两人的位置、推进动作与液体碰撞界面。

禁止固定远景拍完整段落。
禁止长时间背后追拍。
禁止用景深虚化掉关键目标。
除最终碰撞的0.2秒外，其他动作保持快速正常速度。

ACTION READABILITY

> STRONG REACTION

> ELEMENTAL IMPACT

【严格禁止】

两人都主动、强硬、有威胁。

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Photoreal live-action combat footage shot like a war cameraman trapped inside the fight: harsh handheld, shoulder bumps, crash zooms, whip pans, momentary soft focus after impacts, dust on the lens, overexposed sky flashes, crushed blacks in the dirt. Not clean epic coverage, gritty, close, physical, real weight. Wide open battlefield of cracked black basalt and torn grass, ash drifting, heat shimmer. The sky is overloaded fantasy: colossal floating islands grinding slowly overhead, waterfalls pouring into open air, broken stone bridges hanging between them, ember-clouds, twin suns behind mist. Orc armor scrapes, clone footsteps thud, impacts land heavy.
[IMAGE REFERENCES]
Use the provided photo as the ONLY visual reference for the protagonist’s exact face, bald head, thick dark beard, skin, eyes, and body type. He wears a simple black tunic, dark trousers, bare forearms, boots. Every clone is a perfect copy of him — same face, same bald head, same beard, same tunic — distinguishable only by position and what they are hitting. Identity locked for the entire 30 seconds.
[PLACE]
A vast fantasy battle field: basalt plates, grass islands, bone-white dust, wrecked siege banners. Mid-field: a squad of thick orc warriors in scavenged iron, tusks, axes, shields. Deep field: a larger orc warchief with a spiked pauldron and a two-handed blade. Above: floating islands with waterfalls and falling rock. The geography stays consistent as the camera thrashes.
[TIMELINE — 30s, ACTION ALREADY ON]
0-3s: [HOOK — MULTIPLY] Handheld wide-to-tight already running. He stands center foreground in the black tunic, facing slightly toward camera, orcs arrayed left and right, warchief deep center under the floating islands. No warm-up kata. He stomps, body jerks, and dark particle matter rips out of him in a sharp burst — four copies slam into existence around him in under three seconds, left-front, left-back, right-front, right-back, hard landings that kick dust. Five identical bald bearded men in black tunics now occupy the frame. Crash zoom on his face as the last copy solidifies. Orcs flinch and raise weapons.
3-6s: [IMMEDIATE CONTACT] Camera shoves into the mid-ground as the five charge. Left-front copy meets an orc axe with a cross-block and a shoulder check that knocks the orc off balance. Right-front copy slides under a shield and drives a knee into an orc’s midsection. Dirt explodes. Handheld shakes with every hit. Main (center) does not stop — he walks a hard line straight toward the warchief while the copies open the squad.
6-10s: [COPIES CLEAR LEFT/RIGHT] Whip pan left: left-back copy catches an orc’s wrist, turns the guard aside, and lands a short combo of body punches until the orc drops to the dirt. Whip pan right: right-back copy launches a spinning kick that folds an orc over a fallen banner, then pins the shield flat under a boot. Grass and iron rings. Crash zooms on fists and armor. Dust on lens, wiped by camera motion. Main keeps advancing center-frame through the gap.
10-14s: [MID-FIELD SCRUM] High-ish handheld, still dirty, tracking above the scrum. Two copies double-team one armored orc: one clinches from behind, the other drives a flying knee into the chest plate — the orc hits basalt hard, armor clangs. Another orc swings a blade; a copy takes it on a forearm guard, grimaces, and answers with an elbow to the shoulder pauldron. Bodies roll. Fabric rips. The floating islands loom, a waterfall sheet catching twin-sun glare. Main never joins the side fights — continuous forward walk, eyes on the warchief.
14-18s: [PATH CLEARED → WARCHIEF] Medium handheld behind-and-beside the main as the last mid-squad orcs get dropped by copies on both flanks — a takedown slam left, a solid punch to the chest plate right. Dust sheet blows across frame. Ahead: the orc warchief plants his feet, two-handed blade up, roaring. Main breaks into a sprint. Crash zoom on the warchief’s tusks, then on the main’s bald head and beard locked to the photo. Copies stay busy behind him finishing stragglers — visible in soft periphery, still fighting.
18-22s: [WARCHIEF CLASH] They collide center. Blade comes down; main slips inside, shoulder-checks the warchief’s ribs, gets clipped on the tunic, spins with the hit, and answers with a rising punch to the jaw guard. Handheld rides the clinch — too close, elbows, breath, metal. The warchief shoves him back two steps through dirt. A copy flashes in from the left and kicks the warchief’s knee sideways; another copy from the right pulls the blade arm wide. Main resets stance. Triple pressure. Gritty, ugly, real.
22-26s: [FINISH THE CHIEF] Main drives forward again: feint low, then a full-commit straight through the warchief’s guard into the chest plate, followed by a short hook to the side of the helmet. The warchief staggers. Both flanking copies hammer him — left copy a heavy body shot, right copy a kick to the back of the leg. The warchief drops to one knee, then flat onto the basalt, blade skidding away in a spray of dirt. Crash zoom on the weapon sliding. Floating islands still grinding above. Camera breathes hard.
26-30s: [BOARD CONTROL / HOLD] Handheld pulls a shaky wider frame. The five identical bald men stand over the fallen squad and the downed warchief — copies still pinning last moving orcs for one beat, then freezing into a spread formation around the main. Main stands center, black tunic dusty and torn at the shoulder, chest heaving, face locked to the photo, looking past camera toward the next ridge. Ash falls. A chunk of rock shears off a floating island and hits far background. Camera holds the grit and the five silhouettes. End on impact dust, not a clean pose.
[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Gritty handheld action-camera battle footage, multiplication completed inside the first three seconds with particle birth and hard landings, thirty seconds of continuous physical succession, five identical bald bearded men in black tunics locked to the still, orc squad cleared by copies while the main walks then sprints to the warchief, dirty clinch, knee check assist, blade lost, warchief down, fantasy sky of floating islands and waterfalls kept live in background, real dust/fabric/metal/weight, crash zooms, whip pans, lens dirt. Fantasy action only.

Hope you like it! 😎

SUBWAY CAR — 15s — 3 CONTINUOUS TAKES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

@[Image 1](image_1): A tall slender woman with long golden-blonde centre-parted hair in thick loose waves past her chest, high sharp cheekbones, hazel-green eyes, heavy black smoky eye makeup with a hard winged liner. She wears an IVORY satin gown, deep V plunge, narrow straps, floor-length with a high thigh slit, barefoot. She fights long and linear: front kicks, straight knees, reach, and she uses the overhead bars to generate power.

@[Image 2](image_2): A tall lean woman with very long glossy dark brown hair pulled back hard into a tight wet-look bun with no loose strands, strong dark straight brows, deep-set dark eyes with heavy black smoky shadow, bright scarlet mouth. She wears a BLACK satin gown, deep V plunge to a gathered waist, wide shoulder straps, floor-length with a high thigh slit, barefoot. She fights close and rotational: hooks, elbows, throws, and she uses the vertical stanchions to whip her body around.

CRITICAL FRAMING: The camera is INSIDE the car for the entire clip — trapped in the same three-metre-wide space as the fighters, between 0.5 and 3 metres from them at all times. No exterior shots. No wide shots. The camera braces, ducks and swings with the train.

CRITICAL STRUCTURE: Exactly THREE continuous takes, five seconds each. The choreography happens WITHIN each take — the camera follows the action rather than cutting to it. No additional cuts.

PHYSICAL SPACE: The car is 3 metres wide and the ceiling is 2.3 metres. Vaults are HORIZONTAL, not vertical — bodies swing down the length of the aisle, never upward. Vertical stanchion poles every two metres, a horizontal grab bar running the ceiling, hanging straps, moulded bench seats along both walls, sliding doors with laminated glass, ad panels above the windows.

STYLE: Cinematic action blockbuster, photorealistic VFX, practical-stunt aesthetic, wire-work implied. Weight behind every impact, realistic recoil, speed ramping on the biggest hits. Gritty and visceral. Hard contrast: sickly green-white fluorescent from above, flickering; tunnel lights strobing past the windows at speed; occasional blue arc-flash from the third rail throwing hard shadows across the car.

SOUND: The train is the score. Rail clatter, wheel squeal on the curve, the roar of tunnel air. Percussion locked to the rhythm of the track, rising with the fight. No melodic music.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TAKE 1 (0.0–5.0s) — HANDHELD, BRACED, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT
Opens already mid-fight. @[Image 2](image_2) drives @[Image 1](image_1) backward down the aisle with a rising elbow into the sternum — the torso of @[Image 1](image_1) folds around it, breath forced out, and she gives three staggering steps. Instead of falling she catches the overhead horizontal bar with both hands, swings her legs up off the floor and drives both heels into the chest of @[Image 2](image_2). The chest of @[Image 2](image_2) caves around the impact, both feet leave the floor, and she is launched two metres backward down the aisle — her back slams flat into a vertical stanchion pole, spine arching around it, arms flying wide, and she slides down it to a crouch. The camera swings with the kick and settles low. Then the train hits a curve: the whole car lurches hard right, wheels screaming, and both women stagger sideways and grab for something. Real-time.
SFX: elbow thud into the body, forced exhale, the ring of a pole taking a body, rail scream on the curve.

TAKE 2 (5.0–10.0s) — ORBITING LOW, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT
@[Image 2](image_2) comes off the pole into it — one hand locked on the stanchion, she whips her entire body around it horizontally and lands a spinning heel into the jaw of @[Image 1](image_1). The head of @[Image 1](image_1) snaps fully sideways, sweat spraying off the axis of the turn, her knees going loose beneath her, and she falls sideways across a moulded bench seat, the impact folding her over the edge. @[Image 2](image_2) closes to finish it. @[Image 1](image_1) catches a hanging strap, uses it to haul herself up and swing feet-first, and the two of them collide into a grapple against the sliding doors. @[Image 2](image_2) wins the position and drives the back of the head of @[Image 1](image_1) into the laminated door glass — the glass spiderwebs outward in a white star around the impact, her body dropping to her knees against it. As she goes down, @[Image 1](image_1) reaches up and hauls the emergency brake handle. The train brakes catastrophically. Both women are ripped off their feet and thrown down the length of the aisle, sliding, grabbing at pole bases. Speed ramping: real-time into slow-motion on the glass impact, real-time through the brake.
SFX: bone crack on the heel kick, body into moulded plastic, laminated glass fracture, brake handle clunk, then a wall of screaming metal.

TAKE 3 (10.0–15.0s) — TIGHT, LOW, DRIFTING BACK ON THE FINAL BEAT, ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT
The overhead fluorescents cut out. Now the only light is the tunnel strobing past the windows and blue arc-flash from the rails — the entire finish plays in hard flicker. @[Image 1](image_1) rises first. @[Image 2](image_2) charges down the aisle and @[Image 1](image_1) grabs TWO parallel stanchion poles, one in each hand, lifts her body horizontal off the floor between them and drives both heels into the sternum of @[Image 2](image_2) at full extension. The chest of @[Image 2](image_2) collapses around it, both feet leave the floor, and she is launched backward the full length of the aisle — she hits the connecting door at the end of the car, the door bursts open, and she goes down hard in the gangway between cars in a strobe of blue rail-light and roaring tunnel air. The train slows into a station. Platform light floods in. @[Image 1](image_1) walks the length of the car, barefoot, ivory satin torn and streaked with grime, hair wrecked, and steps out onto the platform without looking back. The doors slide shut between them. Through the spiderwebbed glass, @[Image 2](image_2) is still down. The train pulls away. Speed ramping: real-time into slow-motion on the double kick, real-time for the walk-off.
SFX: the double impact as one deep concussive hit, the door burst, tunnel roar, brake hiss, the chime of station doors, then the train pulling out and away into silence.

entries.text: EVERYONE PROMPTS THE ACTION. ALMOST NOBODY LOCKS THE IDENTITY — WHICH IS WHY TWO-CHARACTER SCENES FALL APART.  Two freerunners racing across Tokyo rooftops, eight cuts, corkscrews over a rooftop gap at the end. The parkour is the easy part. Keeping them two separate people who never blend into each other is the part that actually breaks.  Here's the full prompt built that way. Attach two reference photos as image_1 and image_2, and the same structure works for any multi-character action piece:  FORMAT: 15 seconds, 16:9, 1080p, 8-cut cinematic ultra-advanced parkour footage.  CHARACTERS: Two realistic individuals from image_1 and image_2. Use the attached images as absolute character references, and fully maintain the facial features, hairstyles, hair colors, skin textures, body types, height differences, outfits, color schemes, and age appearances of each person across all cuts. No altering into different people, face swaps, outfit changes, hairstyle changes, or mixing of the two individuals' features.  SETTING: A sunny modern Japanese city reminiscent of Tokyo, Shibuya, and Yokohama — rooftops, alleys, staircases, railings, pipes, concrete walls. The two protagonists, as equals, race through at high speed running side by side, following, crossing paths, and coordinating.  CUTS: 1. (00:00–00:01.60) Low-angle rear tracking. Both accelerate side by side and simultaneously kong vault over separate obstacles. 2. (00:01.60–00:03.40) Front low-angle. One wall runs the left wall, the other the right, then tic-tac to cross in midair and land on opposite rooftops. 3. (00:03.40–00:05.20) Lateral tracking. Consecutive precision jumps, then cat leaps to grab and climb a high wall. 4. (00:05.20–00:07.20) Rooftop tracking. The leader dash vaults, the trailer websters over the gap, then they swap front and back positions. 5. (00:07.20–00:09.20) Overhead moving camera. Both dive roll, then run side by side to speed vault a long railing. 6. (00:09.20–00:11.30) Handheld retreating from the front. One underbars, the other side flips, conquering the obstacle simultaneously. 7. (00:11.30–00:13.20) Drone from diagonal rear above. Both palm spin off left and right walls, kong vault, accelerate into the final jump. 8. (00:13.20–00:15.00) Climax. Both leap a large rooftop gap, each doing a corkscrew, camera circling them in midair as they land on separate rooftop edges — then run side by side into the distance.  QUALITY: Live-action film quality. World-championship-level smooth freerunning. Realistic center-of-gravity shifts, muscle movement, natural landing impacts, swaying hair and clothing. Sharp background, natural motion blur only during high-speed movement.  PROHIBITED: Facial distortion, altering into different people, face or body swaps, outfit changes, hairstyle changes, body type changes, limb multiplication, duplicates, body fusion, penetration, warping, floating, unnatural landings, anime style, CG style.  A few things worth noticing about why it's built this way:  The character block does identity work three separate times — the reference images, the "fully maintain" list, and the prohibited list at the end. That redundancy isn't padding; each one closes a different door the model tends to walk through.  The prohibited list names the exact failure modes — face swaps, body fusion, limb multiplication. Telling the model what not to do is more effective here than describing what you want, because these are the specific ways two-character scenes collapse.  Every cut assigns each person a distinct action — one wall runs left, the other right; one underbars, the other side flips. Giving them separate roles keeps them functionally two people, so the model can't average them into one.  And the cuts are individually timed and framed. Long continuous motion is where identity drift creeps in — breaking it into eight discrete shots gives the model less room to blend them.  Made in Seedance 2.0.

Two freerunners racing across Tokyo rooftops, eight cuts, corkscrews over a rooftop gap at the end. The parkour is the easy part. Keeping them two separate people who never blend into each other is the part that actually breaks.  Here's the full prompt built that way. Attach two reference photos as image_1 and image_2, and the same structure works for any multi-character action piece:  FORMAT: 15 seconds, 16:9, 1080p, 8-cut cinematic ultra-advanced parkour footage.  CHARACTERS: Two realistic individuals from image_1 and image_2. Use the attached images as absolute character references, and fully maintain the facial features, hairstyles, hair colors, skin textures, body types, height differences, outfits, color schemes, and age appearances of each person across all cuts. No altering into different people, face swaps, outfit changes, hairstyle changes, or mixing of the two individuals' features.  SETTING: A sunny modern Japanese city reminiscent of Tokyo, Shibuya, and Yokohama — rooftops, alleys, staircases, railings, pipes, concrete walls. The two protagonists, as equals, race through at high speed running side by side, following, crossing paths, and coordinating.  CUTS: 1. (00:00–00:01.60) Low-angle rear tracking. Both accelerate side by side and simultaneously kong vault over separate obstacles. 2. (00:01.60–00:03.40) Front low-angle. One wall runs the left wall, the other the right, then tic-tac to cross in midair and land on opposite rooftops. 3. (00:03.40–00:05.20) Lateral tracking. Consecutive precision jumps, then cat leaps to grab and climb a high wall. 4. (00:05.20–00:07.20) Rooftop tracking. The leader dash vaults, the trailer websters over the gap, then they swap front and back positions. 5. (00:07.20–00:09.20) Overhead moving camera. Both dive roll, then run side by side to speed vault a long railing. 6. (00:09.20–00:11.30) Handheld retreating from the front. One underbars, the other side flips, conquering the obstacle simultaneously. 7. (00:11.30–00:13.20) Drone from diagonal rear above. Both palm spin off left and right walls, kong vault, accelerate into the final jump. 8. (00:13.20–00:15.00) Climax. Both leap a large rooftop gap, each doing a corkscrew, camera circling them in midair as they land on separate rooftop edges — then run side by side into the distance.  QUALITY: Live-action film quality. World-championship-level smooth freerunning. Realistic center-of-gravity shifts, muscle movement, natural landing impacts, swaying hair and clothing. Sharp background, natural motion blur only during high-speed movement.  PROHIBITED: Facial distortion, altering into different people, face or body swaps, outfit changes, hairstyle changes, body type changes, limb multiplication, duplicates, body fusion, penetration, warping, floating, unnatural landings, anime style, CG style.  A few things worth noticing about why it's built this way:  The character block does identity work three separate times — the reference images, the "fully maintain" list, and the prohibited list at the end. That redundancy isn't padding; each one closes a different door the model tends to walk through.  The prohibited list names the exact failure modes — face swaps, body fusion, limb multiplication. Telling the model what not to do is more effective here than describing what you want, because these are the specific ways two-character scenes collapse.  Every cut assigns each person a distinct action — one wall runs left, the other right; one underbars, the other side flips. Giving them separate roles keeps them functionally two people, so the model can't average them into one.  And the cuts are individually timed and framed. Long continuous motion is where identity drift creeps in — breaking it into eight discrete shots gives the model less room to blend them.  Made in Seedance 2.0.

No limit to imagination!

Prompt ⤵️

Prompt : Create a 15-second continuous cinematic hypercar chase through a major city moments before a massive asteroid impact, with every event occurring in one uninterrupted shot. A white hypercar races along an elevated twelve-lane freeway through a dense modern megacity at sunset. A dark-gray pursuit hypercar follows closely. The sky above the city is filled with burning asteroid fragments crossing the atmosphere, leaving enormous glowing trails. Begin with the camera flying backward at road level directly ahead of the white car. Traffic is moving in the same direction at high speed as emergency evacuation begins. The car violently weaves between trucks and buses while the camera remains only a few meters ahead. At second 2, a small asteroid fragment hits a skyscraper several blocks away. A gigantic explosion blows glass and steel outward into the city. The shockwave reaches the freeway. Windows shatter across nearby buildings and several vehicles shift sideways. The camera swings around the white car as it drifts between two buses. The pursuit car closes the gap. At second 5, another asteroid strikes directly ahead near the freeway. The elevated highway begins lifting and twisting from the impact shock. A section of roadway becomes tilted like a giant ramp. The white car accelerates up the rising freeway section. The camera rotates upward alongside the vehicle as the road itself continues moving beneath it. The car becomes airborne. Below, multiple freeway levels collapse onto one another. The camera dives through the open space between falling road segments while tracking the airborne hypercar. The white car lands on the roof of a moving semi-trailer on a lower freeway. Its tires touch the trailer roof for less than a second. The camera sweeps underneath the trailer and emerges beside the car just as it launches from the truck roof onto another highway level. At second 8, a much larger asteroid fragment streaks directly overhead. The entire sky turns orange. A skyscraper ahead begins collapsing sideways toward the freeway. The white car races toward the falling building instead of away from it. As the tower drops, several floors create a temporary sloping surface across the highway. The hypercar drives onto the falling skyscraper facade. The camera follows directly beside it. For one impossible moment the car is racing horizontally across the glass exterior of the collapsing tower while the building continues rotating downward. The pursuit car follows behind. Glass panels explode beneath the tires. At second 12, the white car reaches the far edge of the collapsing skyscraper and launches back onto the freeway. The camera rotates around the front of the vehicle as it lands. Behind it, the skyscraper crashes completely across the highway. For the final seconds, the enormous asteroid itself becomes visible in the sky beyond the city, dominating the horizon. A blast wave from a distant impact races across the city toward both vehicles, flattening street lights, signs and trees. The camera flies backward directly in front of the white car as the shockwave approaches from behind. End a fraction of a second before the shockwave reaches the car. Ultra-realistic large-scale destruction, physically believable freeway collapse, realistic glass, concrete and vehicle dynamics, volumetric atmosphere, asteroid light interacting naturally with buildings and vehicles, accurate motion blur, intense cinematic exposure changes, no cuts, no slow motion, no teleportation.

And whatever surprises are waiting around the bend, drive straight through those too!

entries.text: COLOR GRADE / LOOK FOR THE FULL SHORT Visual Tone: Ultra-realistic, high-budget creature-action with a cold, brutal wilderness feel. Keep the image slightly cooler, with a The Revenant-inspired cinematic look: desaturated greens, steel-grey skies, pale daylight, icy whites, wet blacks, muted earth browns, and restrained highlights. The forest should feel cold and dangerous, with traces of snow residue / frost / chilly mist along the roadside and in the trees, even though the road is drivable. Grade Notes: cool blue-grey shadows soft overcast daylight muted, desaturated greens silver metal rendered cold and hard pale mist, faint winter haze high contrast but naturalistic tactile textures: wet fur, scratched steel, frost, mud, smoke no glossy blockbuster orange-teal look no video-game color grounded, raw, survival-cinema realism  PROMPT 1 (15 SECONDS) — “THE ATTACK”  Ultra-realistic, high-budget creature-action sequence on a narrow forest highway in cold daylight. The visual style is inspired by The Revenant: cool blue-grey shadows, pale overcast sky, muted forest greens, slight roadside snow and frost, drifting mist, wet metal, gritty realism. A silver fuel tanker truck speeds recklessly through a cold forest road while a colossal werewolf, nearly the size of the truck, clings across the tanker. Its soaked black-grey fur is matted and icy, its elongated limbs and hooked claws are buried deep into the metal. It feels heavy, wet, muscular and terrifyingly real.  Shot 1 (0–3s) — Hook: Fast aerial tracking shot descending through the treetops. The tanker swerves violently down the road while the giant werewolf crouches over the silver tank, claws ripping open the steel. Fuel sprays from the ruptured tank. Branches smash across the windshield. Inside the cab, the driver yells into the radio: “It’s tearing the tank open! She’s gonna blow!”  Shot 2 (3–6s): Side tracking shot through the trees. A military helicopter drops into frame and flies parallel to the truck, rotor wash blasting frost, leaves and mist across the road. The werewolf crawls forward over the tanker and slams a huge claw into the cab roof, crushing it inward.  Shot 3 (6–9s): Tight exterior shot by the driver’s side window. The werewolf lowers its massive head beside the cab, roaring inches from the glass. The driver ducks as the creature bites into the rear of the cab, twisting metal away.  Shot 4 (9–12s): The helicopter matches speed beside the truck door on the driver side. The gunner leans from the open door and screams: “Open the door! Jump now!” The driver forces the damaged truck door open against the wind while the helicopter holds dangerously close, its landing skid aligned beside the open cab.  Shot 5 (12–15s): The driver climbs halfway out onto the step as the tanker swerves right beside the helicopter. The werewolf reaches toward him across the cab roof. He prepares to jump towards the helicopter landing skid.  PROMPT 2 (15 SECONDS) — “THE ESCAPE” Direct continuation of the previous scene (upload and tag the scene). Same cold forest highway, same The Revenant-inspired grade: cool, desaturated, slightly snowy, pale daylight, icy mist, wet blacks, muted greens and steel-grey tones. Maintain grounded realism and physical danger.  Shot 1 (0–4s): BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT(BULLET TIME SHOT): The driver launches himself from the open truck door and catches the helicopter’s landing skid with both hands. He swings violently beneath it while the truck races below. The werewolf snaps at empty air, just missing him.  Shot 2 (4–7s): The driver hangs and swings under the helicopter, boots kicking wildly. The gunner grabs his wrist and tries to pull him up while the pilot banks slightly away. Below, the werewolf crashes back onto the ruptured tanker, claws tearing more metal free.  Shot 3 (7–10s): The helicopter gains a little height. The gunner pulls the driver clear enough, then turns back, shoulders a rocket launcher and takes aim at the speeding tanker below. Fuel continues spraying behind the truck in silver arcs.  Shot 4 (10–13s): The gunner fires. The rocket streaks through cold mist, flying leaves and suspended fuel spray, and slams directly into the tanker. A gigantic explosion engulfs the truck and the werewolf. The creature’s roaring silhouette appears inside the fireball as the tanker disintegrates across the road.  Shot 5 (13–15s): Wide rear aerial payoff shot. The helicopter climbs away above the forest while the driver still clings to the skid, swinging beneath it. Behind them, the burning tanker wreck rolls through black smoke and flames on the cold forest highway. The werewolf’s silhouette briefly rises inside the inferno before collapsing.

entries.text:
Never Mess With Tharog
Runnnnnnnn....

Seedance 2.5 on
@videoduck_ai

Prompt Below

STRICT REFERENCE LOCK

[REFERENCE 1 — HUNTER] image2
Use the supplied Hunter reference exactly: same face, hair, beard, physique, fur-and-leather clothing, bow, arrows, quiver and materials.

[REFERENCE 2 — THAROG] image1
Use the supplied THAROG reference exactly: same giant proportions, skull, crescent horns, armored dorsal plates, fur, hide coloration, limbs and tail.

The arrow must remain embedded in THAROG's SAME injured eye after the hit.

Every second below begins from the physical position and movement established in the previous second. Never reset character positions, camera geography, direction of travel or environment.

00:00–00:01 — ESTABLISH

CAMERA: 24mm extreme-wide, low aerial descent.

Hunter crouches behind a foreground boulder on FRAME LEFT. THAROG stands approximately 30–35 meters away on FRAME RIGHT.

A cliff containing a small dark cave entrance is faintly visible far behind Hunter's eventual escape direction.

TRANSITION → Camera continues descending toward Hunter rather than cutting to a different location.

00:01–00:02 — FIND HUNTER

CAMERA: Descending wide naturally becomes an 85mm-feeling compressed close-up through a motivated push-in.

Hunter remains behind THE SAME boulder.

He slowly raises his head and studies THAROG.

THAROG remains visible as a blurred shape behind him.

TRANSITION → Hunter's eyes move downward toward his quiver; camera follows his gaze.

00:02–00:03 — TAKE ARROW

CAMERA: Tilt/pan downward into macro hand detail.

Without changing position, Hunter reaches over his shoulder and smoothly pulls ONE arrow from the quiver.

THAROG remains unaware.

TRANSITION → Camera follows the arrow downward from quiver to bow.

00:03–00:04 — NOCK

CAMERA: Close three-quarter shot of Hunter's hands and torso.

The SAME arrow enters frame continuously and is placed onto the bowstring.

Hunter begins rising from his crouched position behind the SAME rock.

TRANSITION → Camera rises simultaneously with Hunter and settles behind his shoulder.

00:04–00:05 — ACQUIRE TARGET

CAMERA: Over Hunter's right shoulder.

Hunter brings the bow upward.

THAROG's head becomes centered between the bow limbs.

Hunter starts drawing the string.

TRANSITION → Camera pushes along the arrow shaft toward Hunter's drawing fingers.

00:05–00:06 — FULL DRAW

CAMERA: Extreme close-up.

Hunter reaches full draw.

Forearm tendons tighten. Bow limbs bend. String reaches maximum tension.

His breathing briefly stops.

TRANSITION → Stay on the hand until the fingers open, using the bowstring release itself as the transition.

00:06–00:07 — RELEASE

CAMERA: 120fps profile close-up transitioning immediately into arrow tracking.

Hunter releases.

String snaps forward.

Arrow exits the bow.

Camera accelerates alongside it instead of introducing an unrelated angle.

TRANSITION → Camera rotates from side-follow to directly behind the SAME flying arrow.

00:07–00:08 — ARROW FLIGHT

CAMERA: Arrow-follow POV.

The arrow flies through the valley.

THAROG's head rapidly grows larger in frame.

Background streaks naturally from velocity.

TRANSITION → Camera gradually overtakes the arrow and swings around toward THAROG's face immediately before impact.

00:08–00:09 — EYE IMPACT

CAMERA: 120fps extreme three-quarter close-up.

The SAME arrow enters THAROG's ONE EYE.

No excessive gore.

Eyelids contract violently.

Head begins snapping backward.

TRANSITION → Do NOT cut away. Maintain the slow-motion close-up as THAROG's head continues backward.

00:09–00:10 — PAIN REACTION

CAMERA: Slow-motion close-up widening slightly.

THAROG completes the backward head movement.

Arrow remains embedded in the SAME injured eye.

Neck muscles tighten.

Nostrils expand.

Its front foot shifts backward from the shock.

TRANSITION → Slow motion ramps smoothly back toward real time while camera drops lower.

00:10–00:11 — ROAR

CAMERA: 24mm low-angle frontal creature shot.

THAROG violently throws its head upward.

It unleashes a huge territorial roar.

Chest expands.

Dust shakes from armor and nearby stones.

TRANSITION → As the roar ends, THAROG lowers its head directly toward camera.

00:11–00:12 — SEARCH

CAMERA: Slow push toward THAROG's face.

THAROG lowers its head.

One eye remains injured with the arrow embedded.

The functional eye scans left-to-right.

Its breathing becomes increasingly aggressive.

TRANSITION → Camera moves toward the functional eye until the eye fills frame.

00:12–00:13 — THAROG SEES HUNTER

CAMERA: Match transition through THAROG's functional eye into THAROG POV.

Through drifting dust, Hunter is visible beside the SAME boulder from which he fired.

THAROG visually locks onto him.

Hunter realizes he has been detected.

TRANSITION → THAROG POV surges slightly forward; cut on Hunter's reaction.

00:13–00:14 — HUNTER RUNS

CAMERA: 85mm Hunter close-up immediately matching his previous position.

Hunter's eyes widen.

He drops the firing posture but KEEPS THE BOW.

He pivots away from THAROG and begins sprinting.

TRANSITION → Camera swings around Hunter during his pivot and follows behind him.

00:14–00:15 — THAROG CHARGES

CAMERA: Brief reverse tracking shot past Hunter toward THAROG.

Hunter enters foreground while THAROG launches into pursuit behind him.

THAROG lowers its massive horns.

First enormous stride hits the ground.

TRANSITION → Impact vibration becomes camera shake as camera turns back into Hunter's running direction.

00:15–00:16 — CHASE BEGINS

CAMERA: 35mm lateral tracking.

Hunter runs left-to-right across uneven terrain.

THAROG follows along EXACTLY the same travel direction.

Hunter remains approximately 20 meters ahead.

TRANSITION → Camera gradually falls behind Hunter rather than changing screen direction.

00:16–00:17 — CLOSING DISTANCE

CAMERA: Ground-level rear chase shot.

Hunter's boots dominate foreground.

THAROG's enormous legs pound the earth behind him.

The distance decreases.

Hunter jumps over a small rock.

TRANSITION → Camera rises above Hunter as he lands, producing the next overhead view.

00:17–00:18 — REVEAL ESCAPE ROUTE

CAMERA: Rising crane into top-down aerial.

Hunter continues along the SAME path.

THAROG follows.

Ahead, the previously established cliff becomes clearly visible.

A narrow cave entrance can now be seen in the rock wall.

Hunter has NOT noticed it yet.

TRANSITION → Camera dives from overhead toward Hunter's front.

00:18–00:19 — THAROG GETS CLOSER

CAMERA: Front-facing tracking shot moving backward.

Hunter runs directly toward camera.

He glances over his shoulder.

THAROG is now frighteningly close behind.

Each footfall shakes the camera.

TRANSITION → Hunter turns forward again; camera follows his gaze toward the cliff.

00:19–00:20 — VIOLENT PURSUIT

CAMERA: Side tracking with Hunter foreground and THAROG background.

A small dead tree lies directly in THAROG's path.

Hunter passes it.

THAROG does NOT divert.

It smashes straight through it.

TRANSITION → Flying wood fragments cross lens, providing natural foreground wipe.

00:20–00:21 — HUNTER SEES CAVE

CAMERA: Foreground debris clears into Hunter POV.

The narrow cave entrance is now directly ahead.

Hunter immediately recognizes that it can fit him but cannot accommodate THAROG's huge horn crown.

TRANSITION → Rapid push toward cave followed by snap back to Hunter's face.

00:21–00:22 — DECISION

CAMERA: Tight 85mm tracking close-up.

Hunter's eyes lock onto the cave.

No stopping.

No dialogue.

He leans his torso forward and accelerates.

THAROG remains directly behind him.

TRANSITION → Camera pulls sideways while Hunter accelerates, opening into a wide profile.

00:22–00:23 — FINAL SPRINT

CAMERA: Wide 35mm side-tracking shot.

Hunter → THAROG → cave entrance are ALL visible in the SAME composition.

This explicitly establishes geography.

Hunter approaches the cave.

THAROG closes to only several meters behind him.

TRANSITION → Camera accelerates past Hunter and enters the cave BEFORE him.

00:23–00:24 — CAVE APPROACH

CAMERA: 18mm from immediately INSIDE the cave looking outward.

Hunter runs directly toward lens.

THAROG fills more and more of the exterior background.

Hunter prepares to jump.

THAROG's horns remain lowered.

TRANSITION → Camera retreats deeper inside the cave as Hunter launches toward it.

00:24–00:25 — DESPERATE LEAP

CAMERA: 120fps slow-motion backward tracking from inside cave.

Hunter jumps through the narrow opening.

Both feet leave the ground.

Bow stays firmly in one hand.

THAROG's horn crown appears dangerously close behind him.

TRANSITION → Continue tracking backward with Hunter's airborne body until he crosses the cave threshold.

00:25–00:26 — HUNTER ENTERS CAVE

CAMERA: Interior cave, returning smoothly toward normal speed.

Hunter hits the rocky floor.

Momentum carries him into a shoulder roll.

He slides deeper inside.

Outside, THAROG reaches the entrance but is still moving too quickly to stop.

TRANSITION → Keep Hunter foreground while focus racks through the entrance onto THAROG.

00:26–00:27 — THAROG TRIES TO BRAKE

CAMERA: Focus passes through cave opening to exterior side angle.

THAROG desperately plants all four feet.

Claws dig trenches through loose soil.

Its huge body continues sliding because of inertia.

Horn crown remains aimed at the rock surrounding the entrance.

TRANSITION → Track WITH the sliding skull directly toward the cave wall.

entries.text:
夕方の雲海上、象牙色の円形床と真鍮の蜘蛛格子でできた一つの構造物。煙から二頭が異なる質感と重量で顕現し、互いに高低の違う声で威嚇した直後、俯瞰気味の広い画で戦いの最初の一歩が始まる。敵龍_ユーザー原画 は金の角・青緑と桃紫の結晶・重い黒装甲・四脚を持つ翼のない獣の姿。noRow_4 は細い首と脚・薄い大きな翼・黒墨と赤茶の煙・銅金の細い縁を持つ儚い龍の姿。@Image 3は象牙色の核床、真鍮の同心円と蜘蛛格子、右外周梁、右奥の夕日と下の雲海の舞台。参照画像の四分割配置、灰色背景、岩場、塔は採らない。左に龍、右に獣、中央に琥珀色の雲の種。龍と獣は一頭ずつ。獣には翼を生やさない。

Shot 1［0–5秒／柔らかい煙が龍になる］：最初のフレームでは舞台に二頭の完成形は存在しない。夕風に流されてきた細く半透明な黒墨・赤茶の煙が、蜘蛛格子の真鍮線の間をすり抜ける。煙が通過した網目の内側にだけ、普段は見えない琥珀色の小さな雲の種が順に灯る。煙は床上で柔らかい曲線を描いて漂い、互いに触れた細い流れがすぐ固まらず、ほどけて再び結ばれる。カメラは床すれすれの種の接写から、最も細い煙束に沿ってゆっくり横へ移動し、煙が上昇するのと同じ速度でわずかに高さを上げる。まず細い尾の流路、次に胸と長い首の空洞を残した輪郭、最後に薄い左右の翼膜が煙の層として現れる。片眼が開く頃にも胴と翼の内側には夕空が透けて見える。翼根の濃い層、翼端の薄い層、背と尾の煙は異なる速さで流れ、完成後も静止しない。龍が静かに吸気すると細い胸と喉が膨らみ、吐息が種を下から包んで少し浮かせる。銅金の微粒子は煙の外縁だけに控えめに光る。音は薄い風、細かな真鍮の共鳴、龍のかすかな高音の息。全画面を黒煙で覆う転換や、一瞬で完成形へ置き換える変身は避ける。

Shot 2［5–10秒／重い煙が獣になる］：種の光の一つが弱まる瞬間に、右外周梁の床近くへ硬く切る。格子の下の影から濃い黒煙が塊になって押し上がるが、上空へ軽く漂わず、重力に引かれるように低く広がって床の粉を押し出す。龍の絹のような薄い煙と違い、獣の煙は太く遅い渦を巻き、芯に実体ができる。カメラは右前爪が真鍮線を掴む場所とほぼ同じ高さから、爪の移動に沿って短く並走する。最初の前脚が床を圧し、次の前脚、左右の後脚が別々の位置に着地する過程を見せる。四脚の接地が確定すると肩と胸が沈み、重い装甲の輪郭、金の角、青緑・桃紫の結晶、長い尾が煙の内側から順に現れる。カメラは接地した前爪を起点に肩の重量に沿って低く上がり、角と獣の片眼まで小さく回り込む。角や結晶の形が出ても装甲の隙間と背・尾の煙は残り、ゆっくり重く流れ続ける。獣は胸郭を大きく膨らませ、鼻孔から低く荒い息を吐き、右前爪で格子の支点を押さえる。真鍮線がたわみ、細かな粉が横へ走り、中央の雲の種の光が少し暗くなる。着爪の低い衝撃、格子の軋み、獣の腹から響く低い唸りを同期させる。獣は四脚のまま重量を保ち、龍のような透明な翼や飛翔をさせない。

Shot 3［10–15秒／呼応する鳴き声、1秒の引き、開戦］：南側の中広角へ切り、左の半透明な煙龍、中央の弱まりかけた種、右の重い無翼の四足獣を同じ画に置く。明るい象牙色の床と夕空を黒い体の背後に置き、二頭を背景から分離する。龍は種を見て首を低く引き、左前爪を床に刺し、右後脚を半歩後ろへ踏み、薄い右翼を種の前へ斜めに張る。呼吸で胸と喉が動き、翼と尾の煙が流れ続ける。獣は右前爪で網を押さえたまま肩を低くし、四脚の接地を踏み替え、角を龍へ向ける。濃い煙は装甲の隙間から床側へ巻き下りる。龍は胸に息を吸って喉を伸ばし、澄んだ高い威嚇のいななきを放つ。獣はそれに応じて鼻孔を広げ、胸を強く縮めながら低く太い咆哮を返す。二つの声の高さと発声位置は明確に分かれ、音圧で格子と種の光が小さく震える。

鳴き声が重なる終盤の約1秒、カメラは瞬時にズームアウトしながら数メートル後退・上昇し、床に対してやや俯瞰の角度で止まる。真上からの平面図にはせず、二頭の顔、四脚の接地、中心の種、右外周梁、下の雲海を一つの立体的な広い画に収める。近い真鍮線は大きく流れ、遠い夕空は遅く動くことで引きの速さを見せる。引きが止まった直後、獣が右後脚で強く床を蹴って右から左への最初の一歩を始める。龍はそれを見て右翼をさらに斜めに張り、左前爪を踏み替えて迎え撃つ。床の粉塵と二頭の煙が互いに逆向きへ動き、戦いが始まった瞬間でカット。まだ爪は龍に接触しない。龍の右翼は無傷のまま、次の戦闘パートの獣の疾走へ動きでつなげる。

全編で煙は呼吸、接地、翼の開閉、風圧に反応して動き続ける。龍の煙は薄く柔らかい層が流れながら輪郭を作り、獣の煙は濃く低く集まって床へ重量を伝える。二頭を同じ煙の塊として描かない。龍は高い声、獣は低い声。台詞、ナレーション、字幕、文字、BGMなし。鳴き声、風、着爪、格子の共鳴を画面内の動作に同期。最後の1秒のズームアウトは見せ場なので、途中で別のカメラへ切り替えず、後退・上昇・やや俯瞰への一続きのカメラ動作として見せる。

Shot 2［5–10秒／重い煙が獣になる］：種の光の一つが弱まる瞬間に、右外周梁の床近くへ硬く切る。格子の下の影から濃い黒煙が塊になって押し上がるが、上空へ軽く漂わず、重力に引かれるように低く広がって床の粉を押し出す。龍の絹のような薄い煙と違い、獣の煙は太く遅い渦を巻き、芯に実体ができる。カメラは右前爪が真鍮線を掴む場所とほぼ同じ高さから、爪の移動に沿って短く並走する。最初の前脚が床を圧し、次の前脚、左右の後脚が別々の位置に着地する過程を見せる。四脚の接地が確定すると肩と胸が沈み、重い装甲の輪郭、金の角、青緑・桃紫の結晶、長い尾が煙の内側から順に現れる。カメラは接地した前爪を起点に肩の重量に沿って低く上がり、角と獣の片眼まで小さく回り込む。角や結晶の形が出ても装甲の隙間と背・尾の煙は残り、ゆっくり重く流れ続ける。獣は胸郭を大きく膨らませ、鼻孔から低く荒い息を吐き、右前爪で格子の支点を押さえる。真鍮線がたわみ、細かな粉が横へ走り、中央の雲の種の光が少し暗くなる。着爪の低い衝撃、格子の軋み、獣の腹から響く低い唸りを同期させる。獣は四脚のまま重量を保ち、龍のような透明な翼や飛翔をさせない。

Shot 3［10–15秒／呼応する鳴き声、1秒の引き、開戦］：南側の中広角へ切り、左の半透明な煙龍、中央の弱まりかけた種、右の重い無翼の四足獣を同じ画に置く。明るい象牙色の床と夕空を黒い体の背後に置き、二頭を背景から分離する。龍は種を見て首を低く引き、左前爪を床に刺し、右後脚を半歩後ろへ踏み、薄い右翼を種の前へ斜めに張る。呼吸で胸と喉が動き、翼と尾の煙が流れ続ける。獣は右前爪で網を押さえたまま肩を低くし、四脚の接地を踏み替え、角を龍へ向ける。濃い煙は装甲の隙間から床側へ巻き下りる。龍は胸に息を吸って喉を伸ばし、澄んだ高い威嚇のいななきを放つ。獣はそれに応じて鼻孔を広げ、胸を強く縮めながら低く太い咆哮を返す。二つの声の高さと発声位置は明確に分かれ、音圧で格子と種の光が小さく震える。

鳴き声が重なる終盤の約1秒、カメラは瞬時にズームアウトしながら数メートル後退・上昇し、床に対してやや俯瞰の角度で止まる。真上からの平面図にはせず、二頭の顔、四脚の接地、中心の種、右外周梁、下の雲海を一つの立体的な広い画に収める。近い真鍮線は大きく流れ、遠い夕空は遅く動くことで引きの速さを見せる。引きが止まった直後、獣が右後脚で強く床を蹴って右から左への最初の一歩を始める。龍はそれを見て右翼をさらに斜めに張り、左前爪を踏み替えて迎え撃つ。床の粉塵と二頭の煙が互いに逆向きへ動き、戦いが始まった瞬間でカット。まだ爪は龍に接触しない。龍の右翼は無傷のまま、次の戦闘パートの獣の疾走へ動きでつなげる。

全編で煙は呼吸、接地、翼の開閉、風圧に反応して動き続ける。龍の煙は薄く柔らかい層が流れながら輪郭を作り、獣の煙は濃く低く集まって床へ重量を伝える。二頭を同じ煙の塊として描かない。龍は高い声、獣は低い声。台詞、ナレーション、字幕、文字、BGMなし。鳴き声、風、着爪、格子の共鳴を画面内の動作に同期。最後の1秒のズームアウトは見せ場なので、途中で別のカメラへ切り替えず、後退・上昇・やや俯瞰への一続きのカメラ動作として見せる。

entries.text:
努力工作的
@zcre_ai
的新活动测试！

想要做一个什么的、特别显眼又充满个性的开场...
看来得再折腾一下点图了...

[소재 역할]

@Image1
은 분핑쿠의 얼굴·체형·의상만 정의한다. 동일한 성인 한국 여성, 푸른 눈, 일자 앞머리와 긴 검은 생머리, 분홍 카디건, 흰 상의, 검은 플리츠스커트와 안쪽 쇼츠, 흰 양말과 레이스업 부츠, 검은 초커. 콜라주와 배경은 사용하지 않는다.

@Image2
는 젖은 화강암 마당·오른쪽 돌계단·검은 기와 문루·흐린 낮의 조명과 공간을 정의한다. 깨끗한 배경 사진이 전투 중 생긴 파손을 복구시키지 않는다.

@Image3
은 귀면 철가면과 검은 찰갑의 문지기 한 명, 그가 양손으로 사용하는 월도 한 자루를 정의한다. 스튜디오 배경과 정지 자세는 제외한다.

[영상 목표]
이세계 분핑쿠 두 번째 클립. 근접 공방이 계단을 가로지르는 초고속 회전전으로 커지고, 문지기의 반격 에너지를 분핑쿠가 되돌려 거대한 충돌을 만든다.
실사 슈퍼히어로 액션. 얼굴과 몸은 실제 배우처럼, 가속과 파괴력은 초인적으로. 빠른 몸의 이동과 무거운 타격, 접촉 순간에만 짧게 느려지는 시간 대비로 리듬을 만든다.

[시작 상태 — 직전 회피에서 연결]
분핑쿠는 화면 왼쪽에서 무릎을 굽히고 상체를 뒤로 빼며 회피 중이다. 문지기는 화면 오른쪽에서 넓게 발을 벌리고, 월도를 양손으로 잡아 몸 앞에 비스듬히 두고 있다. 젖은 마당, 오른쪽 뒤 돌계단과 돌무더기, 두 사람의 거리와 카메라 높이를 유지한다.
첫 프레임부터 이 자세의 움직임을 이어간다. 회피를 처음부터 반복하거나 정자세로 돌아가지 않는다. 월도가 바닥에 박힌 상태나 분핑쿠가 이미 주먹을 뻗은 상태로 시작하지 않는다. 낙하·착지·대치·능력 소개를 반복하지 않는다.

[능력과 액션 리듬]
PINK INERTIA: 분핑쿠의 실제 신체 회전이 짧은 진주빛 분홍 관성 띠를 만들고, 타격 접점에서 압축되어 넓은 압력파로 폭발한다. 적의 자루 공격을 팔뚝으로 비껴 받으면 접촉부에 에너지가 짧게 모인다. 몸을 틀어 충격을 흘리는 동작 자체가 다음 가속이 된다.

분홍 띠는 신체 경로 → 접촉 → 물·돌·갑옷 반응 → 짧은 소멸 순서로 발생한다. 주먹이 움직이기 전에 효과가 적을 때리지 않는다. 앞 클립보다 회전 반경과 환경 반응이 커지지만 새로운 종류의 마법으로 바뀌지 않는다. 시작 화면에는 효과가 미리 떠 있지 않고, 이어지는 신체 가속을 따라 생긴다.

고속 진입 → 타격 → 적의 즉각적인 반격 → 스치는 접촉과 회피 → 재가속. 두 사람이 공격 차례를 기다리지 않는다. 짧은 감속은 방향을 바꾸기 위한 발 디딤에만 있고, 별도의 준비 자세는 없다.

마이크로 슬로모는 첫 주먹 타격과 마지막 장저 결정타에만 각각 약 0.2초. 나머지는 빠른 실시간. 슬로우에서도 신체·갑옷·물방울이 움직이고 즉시 타임 스냅으로 복귀한다. 충돌 후의 밀려남·추격·반격까지 느리게 늘이지 않는다.

[0–3초 | 회피 → 파고들기 → 타격 → 반격 흘리기]
분핑쿠가 무릎을 더 접으며 머리와 어깨를 낮춘다. 월도가 그녀 앞을 지나가는 틈에, 뒤로 빠졌던 체중을 앞으로 전환해 문지기의 몸통 안쪽으로 짧고 빠르게 파고든다. 칼날을 따라 쫓아가지 않고, 칼날이 지나간 뒤 열린 공간으로 진입한다.

디딘 발에서 골반과 오른어깨로 회전력을 전달해 오른주먹을 하부 흉갑에 꽂는다. 실제 접촉 순간에만 약 0.2초 마이크로 슬로모. 주먹이 갑옷을 밀고 문지기의 몸통이 뒤로 꺾이기 시작한다. 주먹 궤적을 뒤따른 분홍 관성 띠가 접점에 압축된다.

즉시 타임 스냅. 짧고 강한 분홍 압력파가 접점에서 터지며 문지기를 한 걸음 밀어낸다. 발밑 빗물이 충격 방향으로 튄다. 분핑쿠는 주먹을 뻗은 채 멈추지 않고 바로 회수한다.

문지기는 밀린 발로 버티면서 월도의 자루 끝을 되받아친다. 분핑쿠는 왼팔뚝으로 자루의 측면을 짧게 비껴 받아 흘리고, 접촉의 반동으로 몸을 틀어 화면 오른쪽 낮은 계단 쪽으로 빠진다. 그 이동이 다음 구간의 계단 디딤과 고속회전으로 이어진다.

카메라는 직전 화면의 측면 구도에서 두 사람을 함께 따라간다. 얼굴 클로즈업이나 휩팬으로 접점을 가리지 않는다. 무기 통과 → 분핑쿠 진입 → 주먹 접촉 → 압력파 → 적 반격 순서를 지킨다.

[3–6초 | 계단을 이용한 고속회전]
문지기가 회수한 월도를 허리 높이로 휘두르며 압박한다. 분핑쿠는 오른쪽 낮은 계단을 두 걸음 빠르게 밟아 높이를 얻고, 디딘 발로 돌을 강하게 밀어 몸을 수평에 가깝게 틀며 한 차례 회전 도약한다.

월도는 그녀 아래를 통과한다. 회전하는 오른발 뒤꿈치가 문지기의 어깨 철갑을 때리고, 분핑쿠는 바로 마당에 착지한다. 공중에 떠서 계속 회전하지 않는다.

분홍 관성 띠가 계단에서 어깨 접점까지 하나의 넓은 곡선을 그리고, 타격 뒤 물보라가 그 곡선을 따라 터진다. 이 타격에는 슬로모 없이 날카로운 접촉음과 빠른 반응만 있다. 낮은 측면 카메라가 발구름·회전·접촉·착지를 한 경로로 추적한다.

[6–9초 | 무거운 반격과 간발의 회피]
어깨가 돌아간 문지기가 그 회전을 멈추지 않고 월도를 크게 되돌려 벤다. 분핑쿠는 착지한 무릎을 더 접으며 몸통을 뒤로 기울여 칼날을 턱 앞에서 통과시킨다.

칼날은 뒤의 낮은 돌난간 모서리를 깨뜨린다. 회색 석편과 빗물이 실제 절단 방향으로 튄다. 문지기의 위력은 무게와 파손으로 표현하고 분홍 능력을 주지 않는다.

분핑쿠는 지나가는 칼날 뒤를 따라 상체를 되돌리고 곧바로 문지기의 바깥쪽으로 짧게 질주한다. 카메라는 베기의 방향을 따라 짧게 휩팬한 뒤 두 사람을 다시 잡는다. 얼굴을 바라보는 독립 클로즈업으로 멈추지 않는다.

[9–12초 | 반격의 힘을 회전에 실어 돌려준다]
분핑쿠가 사각으로 들어오자 문지기가 자루를 가로로 밀어 진입을 막는다. 그녀는 왼팔뚝으로 자루를 몸 바깥으로 흘리며 왼발을 축으로 피벗한다. 오른팔꿈치를 그의 옆구리 철갑에 짧게 꽂아 상체를 접게 한다.

팔꿈치를 회수하는 동작이 그대로 회전으로 이어진다. 문지기는 몸을 펴며 다시 자루를 휘두르고, 분핑쿠는 그 아래로 낮게 돌아 그의 정면 안쪽에 재진입한다.

분홍 띠는 빠르게 도는 어깨와 팔의 궤적 뒤에 쌓이며 좁은 나선이 된다. 둘이 맞붙어 힘겨루기하거나 충전을 위해 서 있지 않는다. 카메라는 지면을 스치는 돌과 물을 전경에 두어 실제 몸의 속도를 보여준다.

[12–15초 | 회전 반동의 방출]
분핑쿠가 오른발을 내딛고 회전을 짧게 꺾으며 오른손 장저를 문지기의 중앙 흉갑에 박는다.

접촉 순간에만 0.2초 마이크로 슬로모. 팔과 어깨 뒤의 분홍 나선이 손바닥 접점으로 압축되고, 문지기의 갑옷과 몸통이 함께 뒤로 눌린다.

즉시 타임 스냅. 넓고 두꺼운 분홍 압력파가 문지기를 계단 위쪽으로 밀어 날린다. 충격이 계단의 물을 아래에서 위로 연달아 걷어 올리고 가장자리 돌조각이 부채꼴로 튄다. 분홍빛 사이로 적의 몸과 계단이 계속 보인다.

카메라는 접촉을 보여준 다음 빠르게 뒤로 벌어져 마당에서 계단까지 이어지는 파동의 크기를 한 번에 읽힌다. 문루 전체가 무너지거나 장소가 바뀌지는 않는다.

[15–17초 | 끝나기 전에 다시 쫓아붙는다]
문지기가 계단 상부 돌바닥에 부딪혀 미끄러진 뒤 한쪽 무릎과 월도 자루로 버틴다. 분핑쿠는 물보라가 떨어지기 전에 이미 계단을 빠르게 올라간다. 카메라가 그녀의 낮은 3/4 후면에서 뒤따른다.

마지막 프레임: 분핑쿠가 화면 왼쪽 아래에서 오른쪽 위 문지기를 향해 달려들고, 문지기는 상부 계단에서 일어나 월도를 비스듬히 들어 다음 공격을 시작한다. 둘의 거리는 약 두 걸음. 물과 석편은 계속 떨어진다.

돌진과 무기 상승이 진행되는 중 CUT ON MOTION. 승리 포즈·긴 대치·암전 없음.

[촬영과 질감]
한 번의 연속 촬영처럼 인물의 운동을 따라가는 카메라. 결정 접점은 VFX나 휩팬으로 가리지 않는다. 가까운 공방에서는 두 사람과 공격 부위를 함께 보여주고, 마지막 충격파에서만 빠르게 넓어져 환경 규모를 읽힌다.

흐린 낮의 은회색 빛, 젖은 돌과 피부·니트·철갑의 실제 질감. 분홍 효과가 가까운 물과 갑옷에만 짧게 반사된다. 실제 몸의 이동이 먼저 보이고, 잔여 관성 띠와 물보라가 뒤따른다.

[사운드]

[소재 역할]

@Image1
은 분핑쿠의 얼굴·체형·의상만 정의한다. 동일한 성인 한국 여성, 푸른 눈, 일자 앞머리와 긴 검은 생머리, 분홍 카디건, 흰 상의, 검은 플리츠스커트와 안쪽 쇼츠, 흰 양말과 레이스업 부츠, 검은 초커. 콜라주와 배경은 사용하지 않는다.

@Image2
는 젖은 화강암 마당·오른쪽 돌계단·검은 기와 문루·흐린 낮의 조명과 공간을 정의한다. 깨끗한 배경 사진이 전투 중 생긴 파손을 복구시키지 않는다.

@Image3
은 귀면 철가면과 검은 찰갑의 문지기 한 명, 그가 양손으로 사용하는 월도 한 자루를 정의한다. 스튜디오 배경과 정지 자세는 제외한다.

[영상 목표]
이세계 분핑쿠 두 번째 클립. 근접 공방이 계단을 가로지르는 초고속 회전전으로 커지고, 문지기의 반격 에너지를 분핑쿠가 되돌려 거대한 충돌을 만든다.
실사 슈퍼히어로 액션. 얼굴과 몸은 실제 배우처럼, 가속과 파괴력은 초인적으로. 빠른 몸의 이동과 무거운 타격, 접촉 순간에만 짧게 느려지는 시간 대비로 리듬을 만든다.

[시작 상태 — 직전 회피에서 연결]
분핑쿠는 화면 왼쪽에서 무릎을 굽히고 상체를 뒤로 빼며 회피 중이다. 문지기는 화면 오른쪽에서 넓게 발을 벌리고, 월도를 양손으로 잡아 몸 앞에 비스듬히 두고 있다. 젖은 마당, 오른쪽 뒤 돌계단과 돌무더기, 두 사람의 거리와 카메라 높이를 유지한다.
첫 프레임부터 이 자세의 움직임을 이어간다. 회피를 처음부터 반복하거나 정자세로 돌아가지 않는다. 월도가 바닥에 박힌 상태나 분핑쿠가 이미 주먹을 뻗은 상태로 시작하지 않는다. 낙하·착지·대치·능력 소개를 반복하지 않는다.

[능력과 액션 리듬]
PINK INERTIA: 분핑쿠의 실제 신체 회전이 짧은 진주빛 분홍 관성 띠를 만들고, 타격 접점에서 압축되어 넓은 압력파로 폭발한다. 적의 자루 공격을 팔뚝으로 비껴 받으면 접촉부에 에너지가 짧게 모인다. 몸을 틀어 충격을 흘리는 동작 자체가 다음 가속이 된다.

분홍 띠는 신체 경로 → 접촉 → 물·돌·갑옷 반응 → 짧은 소멸 순서로 발생한다. 주먹이 움직이기 전에 효과가 적을 때리지 않는다. 앞 클립보다 회전 반경과 환경 반응이 커지지만 새로운 종류의 마법으로 바뀌지 않는다. 시작 화면에는 효과가 미리 떠 있지 않고, 이어지는 신체 가속을 따라 생긴다.

고속 진입 → 타격 → 적의 즉각적인 반격 → 스치는 접촉과 회피 → 재가속. 두 사람이 공격 차례를 기다리지 않는다. 짧은 감속은 방향을 바꾸기 위한 발 디딤에만 있고, 별도의 준비 자세는 없다.

마이크로 슬로모는 첫 주먹 타격과 마지막 장저 결정타에만 각각 약 0.2초. 나머지는 빠른 실시간. 슬로우에서도 신체·갑옷·물방울이 움직이고 즉시 타임 스냅으로 복귀한다. 충돌 후의 밀려남·추격·반격까지 느리게 늘이지 않는다.

[0–3초 | 회피 → 파고들기 → 타격 → 반격 흘리기]
분핑쿠가 무릎을 더 접으며 머리와 어깨를 낮춘다. 월도가 그녀 앞을 지나가는 틈에, 뒤로 빠졌던 체중을 앞으로 전환해 문지기의 몸통 안쪽으로 짧고 빠르게 파고든다. 칼날을 따라 쫓아가지 않고, 칼날이 지나간 뒤 열린 공간으로 진입한다.

디딘 발에서 골반과 오른어깨로 회전력을 전달해 오른주먹을 하부 흉갑에 꽂는다. 실제 접촉 순간에만 약 0.2초 마이크로 슬로모. 주먹이 갑옷을 밀고 문지기의 몸통이 뒤로 꺾이기 시작한다. 주먹 궤적을 뒤따른 분홍 관성 띠가 접점에 압축된다.

즉시 타임 스냅. 짧고 강한 분홍 압력파가 접점에서 터지며 문지기를 한 걸음 밀어낸다. 발밑 빗물이 충격 방향으로 튄다. 분핑쿠는 주먹을 뻗은 채 멈추지 않고 바로 회수한다.

문지기는 밀린 발로 버티면서 월도의 자루 끝을 되받아친다. 분핑쿠는 왼팔뚝으로 자루의 측면을 짧게 비껴 받아 흘리고, 접촉의 반동으로 몸을 틀어 화면 오른쪽 낮은 계단 쪽으로 빠진다. 그 이동이 다음 구간의 계단 디딤과 고속회전으로 이어진다.

카메라는 직전 화면의 측면 구도에서 두 사람을 함께 따라간다. 얼굴 클로즈업이나 휩팬으로 접점을 가리지 않는다. 무기 통과 → 분핑쿠 진입 → 주먹 접촉 → 압력파 → 적 반격 순서를 지킨다.

[3–6초 | 계단을 이용한 고속회전]
문지기가 회수한 월도를 허리 높이로 휘두르며 압박한다. 분핑쿠는 오른쪽 낮은 계단을 두 걸음 빠르게 밟아 높이를 얻고, 디딘 발로 돌을 강하게 밀어 몸을 수평에 가깝게 틀며 한 차례 회전 도약한다.

월도는 그녀 아래를 통과한다. 회전하는 오른발 뒤꿈치가 문지기의 어깨 철갑을 때리고, 분핑쿠는 바로 마당에 착지한다. 공중에 떠서 계속 회전하지 않는다.

분홍 관성 띠가 계단에서 어깨 접점까지 하나의 넓은 곡선을 그리고, 타격 뒤 물보라가 그 곡선을 따라 터진다. 이 타격에는 슬로모 없이 날카로운 접촉음과 빠른 반응만 있다. 낮은 측면 카메라가 발구름·회전·접촉·착지를 한 경로로 추적한다.

[6–9초 | 무거운 반격과 간발의 회피]
어깨가 돌아간 문지기가 그 회전을 멈추지 않고 월도를 크게 되돌려 벤다. 분핑쿠는 착지한 무릎을 더 접으며 몸통을 뒤로 기울여 칼날을 턱 앞에서 통과시킨다.

칼날은 뒤의 낮은 돌난간 모서리를 깨뜨린다. 회색 석편과 빗물이 실제 절단 방향으로 튄다. 문지기의 위력은 무게와 파손으로 표현하고 분홍 능력을 주지 않는다.

분핑쿠는 지나가는 칼날 뒤를 따라 상체를 되돌리고 곧바로 문지기의 바깥쪽으로 짧게 질주한다. 카메라는 베기의 방향을 따라 짧게 휩팬한 뒤 두 사람을 다시 잡는다. 얼굴을 바라보는 독립 클로즈업으로 멈추지 않는다.

[9–12초 | 반격의 힘을 회전에 실어 돌려준다]
분핑쿠가 사각으로 들어오자 문지기가 자루를 가로로 밀어 진입을 막는다. 그녀는 왼팔뚝으로 자루를 몸 바깥으로 흘리며 왼발을 축으로 피벗한다. 오른팔꿈치를 그의 옆구리 철갑에 짧게 꽂아 상체를 접게 한다.

팔꿈치를 회수하는 동작이 그대로 회전으로 이어진다. 문지기는 몸을 펴며 다시 자루를 휘두르고, 분핑쿠는 그 아래로 낮게 돌아 그의 정면 안쪽에 재진입한다.

분홍 띠는 빠르게 도는 어깨와 팔의 궤적 뒤에 쌓이며 좁은 나선이 된다. 둘이 맞붙어 힘겨루기하거나 충전을 위해 서 있지 않는다. 카메라는 지면을 스치는 돌과 물을 전경에 두어 실제 몸의 속도를 보여준다.

[12–15초 | 회전 반동의 방출]
분핑쿠가 오른발을 내딛고 회전을 짧게 꺾으며 오른손 장저를 문지기의 중앙 흉갑에 박는다.

접촉 순간에만 0.2초 마이크로 슬로모. 팔과 어깨 뒤의 분홍 나선이 손바닥 접점으로 압축되고, 문지기의 갑옷과 몸통이 함께 뒤로 눌린다.

즉시 타임 스냅. 넓고 두꺼운 분홍 압력파가 문지기를 계단 위쪽으로 밀어 날린다. 충격이 계단의 물을 아래에서 위로 연달아 걷어 올리고 가장자리 돌조각이 부채꼴로 튄다. 분홍빛 사이로 적의 몸과 계단이 계속 보인다.

카메라는 접촉을 보여준 다음 빠르게 뒤로 벌어져 마당에서 계단까지 이어지는 파동의 크기를 한 번에 읽힌다. 문루 전체가 무너지거나 장소가 바뀌지는 않는다.

[15–17초 | 끝나기 전에 다시 쫓아붙는다]
문지기가 계단 상부 돌바닥에 부딪혀 미끄러진 뒤 한쪽 무릎과 월도 자루로 버틴다. 분핑쿠는 물보라가 떨어지기 전에 이미 계단을 빠르게 올라간다. 카메라가 그녀의 낮은 3/4 후면에서 뒤따른다.

마지막 프레임: 분핑쿠가 화면 왼쪽 아래에서 오른쪽 위 문지기를 향해 달려들고, 문지기는 상부 계단에서 일어나 월도를 비스듬히 들어 다음 공격을 시작한다. 둘의 거리는 약 두 걸음. 물과 석편은 계속 떨어진다.

돌진과 무기 상승이 진행되는 중 CUT ON MOTION. 승리 포즈·긴 대치·암전 없음.

[촬영과 질감]
한 번의 연속 촬영처럼 인물의 운동을 따라가는 카메라. 결정 접점은 VFX나 휩팬으로 가리지 않는다. 가까운 공방에서는 두 사람과 공격 부위를 함께 보여주고, 마지막 충격파에서만 빠르게 넓어져 환경 규모를 읽힌다.

흐린 낮의 은회색 빛, 젖은 돌과 피부·니트·철갑의 실제 질감. 분홍 효과가 가까운 물과 갑옷에만 짧게 반사된다. 실제 몸의 이동이 먼저 보이고, 잔여 관성 띠와 물보라가 뒤따른다.
